{{Quote|It is not our way. The Counts of Serenno do not complain or cry. We are born to take care of others. We don't expect others to take care of us.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''Serenno''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was known for its aristocratic [[Count/Legends|Counts]], the most famous of them being [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. It was also well known for its long history of resisting authority.<ref name="AotE6">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref>

==History==
===The Old Republic===
[[File:SerennoSurface-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|200px|The forested surface of Serenno at night]]
In about [[3661 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], Serenno was [[Battle of Serenno|attacked]] and captured by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> One thousand years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] Serenno was governed by the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] to which the [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Counts of Serenno]] belonged; the Counts were amongst the wealthiest beings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and believed in [[Wikipedia:Noblesse oblige|''noblesse oblige'']] and self-reliance. Two of the six Great Houses were [[Nalju]] and [[House Demici/Legends|Demici]]. Other lesser noble families allied themselves with the Six or were distant relatives.

Serenno capital backed many projects of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] of which the planet was a valued member, despite being a frequent hotbed of sedition.

During the [[Light and Darkness War]], around the time of the [[Ruusan campaign]], agents of [[Skere Kaan]]'s [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] found their way into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and encountered the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The legion of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] that accompanied Kaan's agents back to the [[New Sith]] Empire settled [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] and soon spread into the larger galaxy.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

In [[990 BBY]], the planet was the site of anti-Republic agitation, and a [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|failed kidnapping attempt]] of former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], both of which failed due to the manipulations of [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. Since the kidnapping attempt involved killing servants and attacking a guest under the protection of Count [[Nalju]], it offended the Great Houses, which quickly took steps to eliminate the seditious movements.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

===Separatist heartland===
{{Quote|I didn't mean to suggest that the Republic is ''purposely'' depriving the outlying systems of the right to self-determination. I'm merely speculating, because I see a growing threat."<br />"You are not alone in seeing it, Magister.|Magister Damask and Jedi Master Dooku discuss the possibility of a coming war|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
Nearly a millennium later, Serenno gave rise to a far more dangerous rebel demagogue. [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was born on Serenno<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> in [[102 BBY/Legends|102 BBY]].<ref name="Birth Years">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> His family bore the title of Count<ref name="ROTS novel" /> and lived in a great house with rose bushes. Dooku once visited the seashell-littered shores of a Serenno ocean as a child. Dooku was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] at a young age and was taken in by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], rising to become one of its foremost [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] and counted among the [[Old Guard]] of the Order.

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Serenno was caught in a dispute with [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] over the placement of new [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]] that would disrupt existing [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroutes]], exposing Serennian ships to greater tariffs. Serenno's Count [[Vemec]] convened a [[Conference on Serenno|conference]] on the issue in a [[Unidentified castle (Serenno)|castle]] with [[Minister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Damask]]&mdash;the head of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and a major figure in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], as well as a Sith Lord&mdash;which was mediated by Jedi Master [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocastu Nu]], assisted by Dooku and his apprentice [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

[[File:Serenno2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Count Dooku on a balcony of a structure on Serenno conversing with his master via hologram.]]
After resigning from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Galidraan]] and the death of Qui-Gon Jinn in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="Plagueis" /> Dooku returned to Serenno and resumed his hereditary title as Count, giving him control of the vast fortune controlled by his family.<ref name="ROTS novel" /> The planet acted as one of his strongholds during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

After murdering [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], Dooku stored his cryogenically frozen body on the planet, to be retrieved several years later for transportation to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where a blood transfusion between the dead Jedi and [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] occurred. As the Clone Wars progressed, Dooku kept his castle on Serenno and used it as a base of operations from time to time. On one occasion, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] contacted Dooku in his palace via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and ordered him to kill his apprentice [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who was growing too powerful and posed a threat to the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]]. Ventress survived, and in retaliation, she led the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] and [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] to raid [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Dooku's palace]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Despite their concealment power, Ventress and her two allies were no match for Dooku, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|hurl]] the three assailants out of the palace, a fall from which they barely survived. After the Skirmish, Dooku received a message from a old ''acquaintance'', Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who offered him a new apprentice, the brother of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="Nightsisters (Episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> Opress was delivered to Dooku by Mother Talzin and a couple of her Nightsisters.<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> It was here Dooku started to train Opress as his new apprentice through brutal exercises.<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

After this Dooku brought eleven of the galaxy's best bounty hunters, which included [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and Obi-wan Kenobi, disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]. Dooku wanted to test to see who was worthy to take part in [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval's]] plot to kidnap the Republic Supreme Chancellor. Dooku then put them in Eval's [[Box/Legends|Box]] to test them.<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>

When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was forced onto the defensive in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Serenno was at the heart of the Serenno theater, the Republic's offensive into Separatist territories in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]. The Republic drove to Serenno from [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]] and [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], hoping to clear the way to the hyperspace crossroads of [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and Dooku's homeworld.<ref name="Warfare" />

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|Lord Vader! This is barbaric! You never spoke of this!''"<br />"''The rest of the Galaxy suffered, so now will Serenno. The houses will be cleansed by blood.|Adan Dooku and Darth Vader|<ref name="AOTE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref>}}
Even after the defeat of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the formal end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, shadowy interests on Serenno continued to back [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. During the [[Ciutric Offensive]], Separatist forces that had fled from [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] into the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]] were funded by Serenno, while Serennian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] assisted in breaking the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Siege of Binquaros]] and helping the Separatists there evacuate.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Cleansing_of_Serenno.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader turned the heirs of Serenno against their fathers.]]
Shortly thereafter, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] drove the heirs of the Great Houses of Serenno to mass parricide that came to be known as the [[Cleansing of Serenno]]. As a result, the Great Houses were brought in the bosom of the newly formed Galactic Empire, and [[Adan Dooku]] was appointed Count of Serenno, liege lord of all the other [[Noble/Legends|patricians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Most of the [[galactic community]] never knew what really happened on Serenno that day, only that the event had seen the replacement of the old heads of houses by their sons. Agent [[Jahan Cross]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was one of the few to ever learn the true story of the Cleansing of Serenno, which he heard in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] from the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin]], who had drawn the first blood during the massacre.<ref name="AOTE2" />

Five days after the death of Adan Dooku, the various Serenno houses held a [[Dooku regency conclave|conclave]] to appoint a [[Regent/Legends|regent]] ruler to rule in [[Bron Dooku]]'s place until he came of age; as an official Imperial envoy, Agent Jahan Cross was naturally invited to attend these normally highly exclusive discussions. Though assigned to ensure Rodas Borgin's appointment as regent, Cross took it upon himself to protect the child of the man he himself killed. The main negotiator at the meetings was Cross's father, [[Davim Cross]], who was skeptical of Jahan's supposed non-involvement with the death of Count Dooku.<ref name="AOTE2" />

The next round of meetings took place aboard the Dooku airship, the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']]. In the midst of negotiations, the airship was [[Attack on the Windrunner|attacked]] by a pirate airship known as the ''[[Bloodskull]]''. Commanded by Vex, operating under the employment of Rodas Borgin, the pirates attempted to capture Bron Dooku.<ref name="AotE3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Unidentified House Demici heir|heir]] of Count [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]] set out to hunt [[split-tail dorsallope]] with a dozen of [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guard]] and went missing near the House Nalju territory. His father, Count Demici, suspected the rival House Nalju for his son's disappearance.<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>

Count Demici hired a group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] to locate his missing heir. During their investigation in Nalju territory, they were captured and accused of espionage and brought to a [[Unidentified House Nalju encampment|House Nalju encampment]] led by a [[Unidentified House Nalju heir|heir]] of Count [[Unidentified House Nalju count|Nalju]]. Young Nalju claimed that he was investigating a sighting of House Demici Noble Guard and that he would gladly escort the Demici heir home if he found him, in order to avoid war between their houses. The group learned that House Nalju was not responsible for the boy's disappearance.<ref name="FH" />

In the middle of the night, the Nalju encampment was [[Raid on a House Nalju encampment|attacked]] by House Demici Noble Guardsmen. The heir to House Nalju was stunned and abducted into the forest. The group followed the kidnappers to a canyon. Once inside, they discovered the two heirs have allied to drive their houses to war. They had planned to kill their fathers during the confusion and take over their respective houses, and after a brief arms race, unite House Demici and House Nalju and dominate Serenno.<ref name="FH" />
{{Endgame}}

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] set up a base on Serenno<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-1|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> and used the planet as a capital of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]].<ref name="TEA" />
